title.narrative: Improved community level response to climate change in Borno State

description.narrative: The programme will improve community level response to climate change in Borno State by promoting the implementation of climate actions that will directly and equitably support the climate resilience of up to 60,000 conflictaffected men, women, boys and girls in Jere and Konduga Local Government Areas. The programme is in accordance with the EUs overall objective of promoting and protecting human rights for all. By promoting the climate resilience of crisisaffected persons, the programme will support them to achieve a range of human rights goals including those to life, food, health, water and sanitation and selfdetermination.

title.narrative: Impact indicator 1: % of targeted population reporting enhanced standards of living as a result of climate

description.narrative: Impact indicator 1: % of targeted population reporting enhanced standards of living as a result of climate

comment.narrative: The baseline value is zero as the indicator measures the projects investment in SME sector
min. 5 gres par des femmes dans les positions de gestion active
EURF value equals current value. No risk of double counting. 10 entreprises ayant accs aux services financiers par lUE.

description.narrative: The programme will improve community level response to climate change in Borno State by promoting the implementation of climate actions that will directly and equitably support the climate resilience of up to 60,000 conflictaffected men, women, boys and girls in Jere and Konduga Local Government Areas. The programme is in accordance with the EUs overall objective of promoting and protecting human rights for all. By promoting the climate resilience of crisisaffected persons, the programme will support them to achieve a range of human rights goals including those to life, food, health, water and sanitation and selfdetermination.
